spiritgiven.comments: There was a praise when the both team played a good play so it was a good spirit!
I realized there were body contacts sometimes but overall we were able to solve the problems. Thank you for the long game!
Although when we score, Ireland team did praise us and did high five for us. It was a good spirit! Thank you for the good communication.
Thank you for the close game, both team had tough game!
It was the toughest game ever and everyone did really hard on playing. I think it will be really appreciated if you guys care about the disc space the next game! Good luck!
Thank you for the good game!! You guys play smart and inside flicks were amazing! Good luck for the rest of the tournament.
It was a good game including the plays and the spirits. When someone in our team was fell down, somebody in your team did care us and that was a good spirit! Thank you for the hard game!
There were a praise when both team scored and we did fist bumps a lot so it was such a spirited game! Thank you for the good game! Good luck in the next and the last game!!
It was a really really tough game and difficult game for us. Although we did trying our best we still lost. There were a lot of good plays, you guys deserves to win! Thank you for the good game!

spiritreceived.comments: There were small rules things that they didn’t know (changing places on the line, changing pivot feet, traveling when bringing the disc to the front of the endzone), but we felt they were not enough to give them a 1. For communication, we understand that it’s hard to bring the translator every thing there’s a discussion, but we think they could have used more hand signals and they were stalling in Japanese sometimes. We thought their fair mindedness and attitude were very spirited! Great game!!!
Fun and intense game! If they could speed up putting a line on offense it would be great!
Thanks for the spirited game, all calls were settled smoothly and well despite having communication barriers!
Really good layouts, speed, accuracy in passing. High spirits. Thanks for such a good, fun game. Good luck in the rest of the tournament!
Really intense but spirited game. Great long shots and connections.
Thank you for the challenging match! It was hard to communicate becouse of the language barriers but we still maneged to tolk to eachother!
There was very minimal body contact and plays were made safely. Communication was excellent even with a language barriers for many team members.
Thank you Japan for this hard fought game! You are so incredibly quick both on the field and in your heads, which, combined with your friendly attitude, made this game a highlight :)
Crazy good long shots and grabs to back them up. Put up a really good zone. Amazing fight till the end and great spirit too.
